name: Neon Sign at Night
description: Hand-bent glass neon on an old brick wall after rain: white-hot tube cores, saturated colour halos, painted-out blockout tube, clips and electrodes, light spilling across the brickwork and smearing in the wet pavement.
motionNotes: Motion: Tubes buzz on letter by letter with a stutter, one failing letter keeps flickering, and the puddle reflection shivers as drops land.
explainerNotes: Explainer: One long brick wall the camera whip-pans along: every beat is a new neon sign that buzzes on tube by tube, arrows are segmented chase-light tubes that ignite toward their target, numbers are neon digits re-lit as they change, and the emphasis is a blinking red tube with a ring.
